(Nasdaq: RANI), a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company focused on oral delivery of biologics,
body_text: PDF Version ~ Former Chief Financial Officer of Arcellx Brings Deep Capital Markets and Biotech Financial Leadership Experience ~ SAN JOSE, Calif., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rani Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: RANI), a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company focused on oral delivery of biologics, today announced the appointment of Michelle Gilson to its Board of Directors. Ms. Gilson will serve as Chair of the Audit Committee. "The combination of deep capital markets expertise and hands-on financial leadership at a high-growth biotechnology company makes Michelle an exceptional addition to our Board," said Talat Imran, Chief Executive Officer of Rani Therapeutics. "Her experience guiding Arcellx through its partnership and acquisition by Gilead gives her a firsthand understanding of how disciplined financial strategy and strong corporate governance can translate into significant value creation. As we continue to advance our pipeline and pursue strategic opportunities, Michelle's insight will be invaluable to Rani and our shareholders." "I'm honored to join Rani Therapeutics' Board of Directors at such a pivotal time for the company," said Michelle Gilson. "The RaniPill® technology represents a truly differentiated approach to one of the biggest unmet needs in medicine today — the burden of injectable biologics. I look forward to working with the Board and management team to support the company's continued growth." Ms. Gilson most recently served as Chief Financial Officer of Arcellx, Inc. which was acquired by Gilead in 2026. During her tenure, Ms. Gilson played a central role in the company's financial strategy and corporate development as the company scaled from Phase 1 through its Biologic License Application (BLA) submission and was instrumental in Arcellx's landmark collaboration with Kite, a Gilead Company, and subsequently in Gilead Sciences' acquisition of Arcellx — one of the most significant recent transactions in the cell therapy space. Prior to joining Arcellx, Ms. Gilson spent her career as a biotechnology equity research analyst at leading investment banks, holding roles at Canaccord Genuity, Jefferies, Nomura, Oppenheimer & Co., and Goldman Sachs. This background gives her a distinctive vantage point on capital markets, investor relations, and the financial dynamics that shape the biotechnology industry. Ms. Gilson holds a B.S. in Business Administration from the University of Southern California. About Rani Therapeutics Rani Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company focused on advancing technologies to enable the development of orally administered biologics and drugs. Rani has developed the RaniPill® Capsule, a novel, proprietary and patented platform technology, intended to replace subcutaneous injection or intravenous infusion of biologics and drugs with oral dosing. Rani has successfully conducted several preclinical and clinical studies to evaluate safety, tolerability and bioavailability using RaniPill® Capsule technology. title: Life at MySivi: Our Culture, Careers & Mission
summary: Discover what life at MySivi is really like. Explore our unique work culture, read employee stories, and find your career in a leading AI startup.
body_text: Discover what life at MySivi is really like. Explore our unique work culture, read employee stories, and find your career in a leading AI startup. Do you want to build technology that genuinely changes lives? Are you looking for a place where your ideas have a direct impact, and you can see your code or campaigns empower millions? This is a glimpse into life at MySivi , where we’re not just building an app; we’re building confidence. We are on a mission to help every Indian speak English fluently and fearlessly . This mission is the core of our identity, shaping our products, our goals, and the culture we build every single day. If you’re driven by purpose and thrive on solving complex challenges, you might have just found your team Quick Answer: What Is Life at MySivi Really Like? Life at MySivi is a blend of a fast-paced AI startup environment and a mission-driven focus on user impact. The work culture prioritizes ownership, continuous learning, and direct collaboration. We build cutting-edge AI-powered tools that help learners across India and around the world speak English with greater confidence. Our AI English teacher helps improve pronunciation, accent, grammar, and real-world communication through personalized practice and feedback. Key Takeaways Mission-Driven: Our primary goal is to help people from every corner of the world speak English with confidence . Whether you’re a beginner or looking to improve your pronunciation, grammar, accent, or everyday communication, we’re here to make English speaking easier and more accessible for everyone. High-Impact Roles: Every team member, from engineering to marketing, directly influences the learning journey of our users. Culture of Ownership: We believe in giving our team the autonomy to innovate and take charge of their projects. Continuous Learning: Just like our users, we are always learning, experimenting, and improving our skills and our product. Inside MySivi’s Work Culture At its heart, the MySivi work culture is built on a single, powerful idea: empowerment. We empower our users to find their voice, and we empower our team to do their best work. This isn’t about ping-pong tables or free snacks; it’s about creating an environment where talented people can solve a meaningful problem. Our culture is defined by three core principles: User-First, Always : Every decision we make starts with the question, “How does this help our user speak English more confidently?” Our product roadmaps, marketing campaigns, and engineering sprints are all guided by user feedback and data. Radical Ownership: We hire smart people and trust them. You won’t be a cog in a machine at MySivi. You’ll own projects from start to finish, with the freedom to experiment and the responsibility to deliver results. Data-Informed Empathy: As an AI startup in India , we live and breathe data. But we also understand the human story behind the numbers. We blend analytics with real user stories to build an AI English tutor that is not just smart, but also supportive and encouraging. No Cap, We’re Solving Core Comm Issues (While Failing Our Own Regional Language Challenges) When you look at our tech, we are building a state-of-the-art AI English tutor to help millions speak fluently. But if you scroll through our @life_at_mysivi Instagram , you will see the real, unhinged truth: behind the world-class code is a team of humans fiercely battling their own corporate vocabulary blocks and office quirks. We are not robots building robots; we are a chaotic, brilliant family that balances high-impact machine learning with top-tier desk humor. [ High-Tech AI English Engine ] ▲ │ (Powered by) ▼ [ Pure Office Caffeine + Work Bestie Banter ] Why Our IG Chaos Makes Us Better Builders We practice what we preach: Our app fixes broken corporate communication. Meanwhile, our team uses Instagram Reels to mock our own overused phrases like “Nice, Good, and Okay.” The regional language tax: We build tools for diverse Indian backgrounds. In the office, we test each other with impromptu language challenges that usually end in hilarious, humbling fails. Work besties over corporate jargon: We trade stiff hierarchy for raw, unfiltered collaboration. If an idea is good, it ships—no matter if it came from a senior engineer or an intern. The Deep Truth: Empathy is Born in the Bloopers We don’t hide our workplace bloopers because data-informed empathy requires understanding the actual friction of learning. By laughing at our own communication stumbles on camera, we build a supportive, judgment-free AI that helps users overcome the same fear of looking foolish. We lock in during sprints, but we never take ourselves too seriously. Employee Experiences and Stories at MySivi Values on a wall are meaningless. It’s the people who bring a culture to life. Here are a few stories that capture the essence of working at MySivi . The Engineer Who Ships Code That Speaks “I joined MySivi from a large MNC. The biggest change? The speed of impact. Last month, our team was brainstorming how to give better feedback on filler words like ‘um’ and ‘ah’. Within three weeks, we designed, built, and shipped the feature. A few days later, I read a user review saying, ‘MySivi helped me stop saying ‘ah’ in my interview practice!’ That direct line from my code to someone’s confidence is something I never experienced before.” – Keyur Kanjiya , Senior Software Engineer The Marketer Connecting with India's Aspirations “Our user isn’t just a download metric. It’s a student in a small town preparing for their first job interview, or a professional in Bengaluru trying to lead a client call. My job is to understand their journey. We don’t just market an app; we share stories of transformation. The MySivi employee experience is about being deeply connected to that mission. We know that in India, proficiency in English can unlock enormous opportunities, with some reports suggesting it can increase income by up to 34%.” – Niranjan R Kumar , Senior Full Stack Marketer What Makes MySivi Different? The Indian startup ecosystem is vibrant and competitive. So, what makes the MySivi company culture stand out? It’s our focus on solving a foundational problem with deep technology. Aspect A Typical Tech Startup Life at MySivi Primary Goal Focused on growth, valuation, and market share. Focused on measurable user empowerment and meaningful learning outcomes. The Work Building features for a specific market segment. Building an AI-driven English learning app for learners from diverse backgrounds and regions. Impact Impact is often measured through business metrics and growth numbers. Impact is direct, personal, and visible through user progress, feedback, and improved communication skills. Learning Usually centered around a specific technology, product, or domain. Encourages cross-functional learning across AI, linguistics, user psychology, content, and product development. Innovation Innovation is often driven by market competition and business needs. Innovation is driven by finding smarter ways to make English learning more accessible, practical, and engaging . Users Primarily focused on a defined customer segment. Designed for English learners across India and beyond who want to improve their speaking, pronunciation, grammar, and confidence. Culture Role-based work with defined responsibilities. A collaborative environment where people experiment, learn, solve problems, and contribute beyond their core roles . We are not just another app. We are a dedicated team building a companion for one of the most personal journeys someone can take: finding their voice. Inside Life at MySivi: Work, Culture & Growth The culture at MySivi isn’t just about ambitious goals and fast-paced work. It is also about the people you work with every day. From new employees to senior team members and decision-makers, there is a strong sense that everyone can speak up, ask questions, and contribute ideas. Seniors Who Listen, Teams That Help One of the things that makes the work environment comfortable is the accessibility of senior team members and decision-makers. When an employee faces a problem, whether it is related to the product, technology, content, or a user issue, there is always an effort to understand the problem rather than simply pass it down the hierarchy. The focus is on solving the problem quickly and learning from it . This becomes especially important when users report problems with the app. A client issue isn’t treated as just another support ticket. The team tries to understand what went wrong, why it happened, and how the experience can be improved for other users as well. Solving Real English-Speaking Problems Building an English-speaking app means understanding that the real challenges learners face are often much deeper than simply knowing grammar rules. A learner may know the right words but struggle to put them together naturally while speaking. Someone may understand English perfectly but freeze during an interview or client call. Others may translate sentences mentally from their first language before speaking, resulting in unnatural sentence structures or long pauses. Some learners repeatedly use fillers such as “umm,” “actually,” “basically,” and “you know” because they are thinking about what to say next. Others struggle with word stress, sentence rhythm, pronunciation, or sounds that don’t exist in their native language. Some may pronounce every word correctly individually but still sound unclear because their intonation, pacing, or connected speech is not natural. These are the kinds of real-world communication problems the team tries to understand. Instead of assuming what learners need, the team looks at user conversations, feedback, reviews, and recurring problems to identify where learners are actually struggling. Training the AI With Real Learner Needs Improving the app is not a one-time process. The team continuously works on training and adding relevant data to the product based on the problems users are facing. If users repeatedly struggle with a particular situation, such as introducing themselves in an interview, answering follow-up questions, handling a client conversation, participating in a meeting, or speaking spontaneously, the team looks at how that scenario can be represented better inside the app. This creates a continuous loop: User problem → Team identifies the pattern → Data and training improve → Product gets better → Users get better practice. It means that every day user feedback can influence what the team builds next. An Office Environment Where Learning Is Part of the Work The office environment is energetic, collaborative, and approachable. People work seriously when the problem demands it, but there is also room for conversations, humour, experimentation, and the occasional office blooper. That balance matters. Working on a product that helps people overcome their fear of speaking English also requires the team to understand that making mistakes is a normal part of learning. The same philosophy applies internally: people are encouraged to experiment, ask questions, make mistakes, learn quickly, and improve. This connects naturally with the team’s social content too. The humour and bloopers shared through Life at MySivi are not separate from the culture—they are a reflection of a workplace where people can be serious about the mission without taking themselves too seriously. Making English Learning More Accessible Another important part of the mission is accessibility. The goal isn’t simply to build sophisticated AI technology. It is to make meaningful English-speaking practice available to people who may not have access to expensive personal coaching or regular opportunities to speak English. That means the team constantly thinks about how to make the product useful, practical, and affordable . Whether someone is preparing for their first interview, trying to speak more confidently at work, struggling with pronunciation, or simply looking for someone to practise English with every day, the product is being built around real communication needs—not just textbook English. Everyone Contributes to the Mission At MySivi , the boundary between “my job” and “the user’s problem” can sometimes become quite small. An engineer may investigate a user-reported issue. A marketer may notice a recurring communication problem through user feedback. A content team member may identify a difficult English concept that learners repeatedly search for. A senior team member may jump into a discussion to help unblock a problem. That cross-functional approach is part of what makes the culture different. The objective is not simply to finish a task and move on. It is to understand why the task matters to the person using the product . Ultimately, that’s what the culture at MySivi is trying to create: a workplace where people work together, seniors remain approachable, problems are solved quickly, mistakes become learning opportunities, and the product keeps getting better because the team stays close to the real problems English learners face. MySivi Careers: Build the Future of Communication Are you ready to do the most meaningful work of your career? We are always looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our team. We have ambitious goals, and we need a diverse team of thinkers, builders, and dreamers to achieve them. At MySivi, you won’t just have a job; you’ll have a mission. You’ll work on challenging problems in Natural Language Processing, machine learning, product design, and growth that directly impact millions of aspiring English speakers. Explore our open roles and see how you can contribute to the MySivi team . We’re hiring for roles in: * AI & Machine Learning * Software Engineering (Mobile & Backend) * Product Management * Marketing & Growth * User Experience Design Even if you don’t see a perfect fit right now, we’d love to hear from talented individuals who believe in our mission. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) What is the work culture at MySivi? The MySivi work culture is mission-driven, fast-paced, and collaborative. We prioritize user impact, grant our teams high levels of ownership, and use data to make empathetic decisions. It’s an environment ideal for proactive individuals who want to solve meaningful problems. Where is the MySivi headquarters? Our team operates in a hybrid model to attract the best talent from across India, with a central collaboration hub in Bengaluru. We believe in providing flexibility while fostering a strong, connected MySivi team culture through regular in-person and virtual collaboration. MySivi a good company to work for? MySivi is an excellent place for individuals passionate about AI, education, and social impact. If you thrive in a startup environment where you can take ownership, see your work’s direct impact, and contribute to a meaningful mission, you will find working at MySivi very rewarding. What kind of MySivi jobs are available? We offer various MySivi career opportunities across technology, product, and business functions. This includes roles like AI/ML Engineer, Mobile App Developer, Product Manager, Content Creators, Performance marketer , and Digital Marketing Specialist. Check our official careers page for the most up-to-date listings. How does MySivi support employee growth? We support growth through challenging projects, mentorship from senior leaders, and a culture of continuous learning.
